about: Gold evaluation set for the Flame-in-Freefall RAG layer. Layer 4 of the accuracy design.
method: Expected investigations were derived by counting term occurrences across the built corpus (data/index/chunks.jsonl) and keeping the investigations that dominate each term, not by guessing. 'expect_any' means at least one must be retrieved; 'expect_all' means every one must be. Negative cases assert the system refuses or warns rather than answering.

cases.question: Which experiments burned PMMA samples?
cases.note: 244 PMMA chunks; BASS-II (122) and BASS (75) dominate.

cases.question: What is known about cotton fabric flammability in microgravity?
Which investigations used SIBAL fabric samples?
cases.note: 55 SIBAL chunks, split between BASS-II and BASS.

cases.question: Was Nomex tested for flammability?
What smoke particle sizes were measured in microgravity?
cases.note: SAME (22) and SAME-R (18) hold essentially all of this.

cases.question: How do spacecraft smoke detectors respond in microgravity?
What obscuration measurements exist for microgravity smoke?
cases.note: Only 9 chunks corpus-wide; a hard recall case.

cases.question: What did the dust and aerosol measurement feasibility test find?
Which fire suppression agents were tested on burning droplets?
cases.note: FLEX test plan carries the suppressant efficacy table.

cases.question: Which experiments burned n-heptane droplets?
What was observed burning methanol droplets?
What are cool flames and which investigations studied them?
How do electric fields affect laminar diffusion flames?
cases.note: 359 of 470 electric-field chunks are ACME E-FIELD.

cases.question: What is known about flame liftoff in reduced gravity?
cases.note: SLICE (PSI-106) is the natural owner but is excluded - no documents in PSI.

cases.question: What is the burning rate emulator and what does it measure?
What soot measurements were made on gaseous flames?
What did the smoke point in co-flow experiment investigate?
What did the large-scale spacecraft fire experiments find?
cases.note: SAFFIRE must be retrievable AND must be flagged as thin evidence.

cases.question: How fast does flame spread in a lunar habitat at one sixth gravity?
cases.note: PSI has no partial-gravity data. Must warn, not answer.

cases.question: What is the burning rate of PMMA on Mars?
Show me partial gravity combustion measurements.
Does microgravity flammability data apply to Mars habitats?
cases.note: Asks about the extrapolation itself, so a softer warning is correct.

cases.question: Which experiments burned solid fuels and what suppression agents worked?
What smoke particle sizes were measured; how were they detected?
Give an overview of the ACME investigations.
cases.note: ACME documents are byte-identical across PSI-10/20/22/23. The ledger must contain no repeated source text.

cases.question: What oxygen concentrations were used in BASS-II PMMA tests?
cases.note: Any number surfaced must be traceable to a retrieved chunk or a condition row.
